Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，有一个老男人叫神农。神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，所以他决定开始找新的药。他下一天开始爬当地的山脉，找了各种各样的植物。神农试一试每个植物，知道有什么好处。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 有一个老男人叫神农：老人，“老男人“ has negative meaning
- 神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服：delete “在古代”, it implies that 神农can travel between 古代 and 现代modern times; 都看到，no了for routine/habit; 别的小镇上的人；生病或者不舒服
- 他下一天开始爬当地的山脉：第二天，当地的大山，山脉is for geography

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 有一个老男人叫神农：有一个叫神农的老人，A name used as a modifier should come before the noun with 的; 老人 is also a more neutral term for an elderly man in this story. [rule: attributive_modifier_de]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的小镇人：人们，别的 distinguishes one group from another previously mentioned group, but no comparison group has been established here. [teacher rule: bieren]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 还是：或者，In this declarative sentence, the two conditions are alternatives, so use 或者 rather than the question-choice connector 还是. [rule: none]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 下一天：第二天，Use 第二天 to mean “the next day” in a narrative. [rule: time_expression]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 找了各种各样的植物：找到了各种各样的植物，找 describes searching, while 找到 expresses successfully finding the plants. [vocab list]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 每个植物：每种植物，种 is the appropriate measure word for kinds of plants. [rule: none]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：他，After the first mention, use a pronoun when the same character is still the clear subject in the next sentence. [rule: redundancy_delete]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 所以他决定：所以决定，When the subject remains the same within one sentence, use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：他，The preceding sentence already has only one clear character, so a pronoun is more natural for this close re-occurrence. [rule: redundancy_delete]
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每一天看到了：每天看到，This describes a routine, so use the zero particle rather than 了, which marks a completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
11. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，所以：因为神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，所以，Use the paired cause-and-effect connector to show that seeing sick people caused his decision. [rule: none]

items.reason: “老男人” has an inappropriate negative connotation here, while “有一个叫神农的老人” is correct.
“别的小镇人” is not a well-formed way to say people in another small town, and replacing the entire phrase with “人们” loses that meaning.
In this declarative alternative, “或者” is required rather than “还是.”
“第二天” is the appropriate narrative expression for the following day.
“找了各种各样的植物” can correctly mean that he searched for various plants; adding 到 changes the meaning rather than correcting an error.
“每个植物” is acceptable when referring to individual plants, although “每种植物” would mean each kind of plant.
After 神农 has just been introduced, the close re-reference should be “他” under the teacher’s reference rule.
The subject remains 神农 within the same sentence, so it can be omitted before “决定.”
The preceding sentence has the same clear subject, so “他” is required for this close re-reference.
A habitual action with “每一天” should use zero aspect, as in “每天看到.”
Adding “因为” correctly supplies the required 因为……所以 connection, but the displayed corrected clause still contains other errors.
